body:
Macquarie Group Limited raised AUD 1.45 billion through a bond offering, including a 10-year floating-rate note, and Macquarie stock was trading at EUR 157.67 at Lang & Schwarz on October 12, 2026 at 9:48 a.m. CEST. The Australian reported the capital raising on September 22, 2026, when demand reached AUD 3.00 billion. The structure gives the financing event more weight than a routine debt issue because one tranche carries a 10-year maturity.

Three milestones shape the story

Macquarie generated AUD 4.85 billion in net profit for fiscal 2026, up 30.00 percent from the previous corresponding financial year, according to The Australian on September 22, 2026. The profit comparison places the new financing in the context of a larger earnings base rather than treating the bond issue as an isolated balance-sheet event.

On May 8, 2026, Macquarie reported its fiscal 2026 result with net profit of AUD 4.85 billion. On September 22, 2026, the group raised AUD 1.45 billion in bonds. On October 1, 2026, UBS lifted its target to AUD 265.00 while retaining a neutral rating, as TradingView reported.

What does the bond raise change?

The AUD 1.45 billion offering is regulated capital, and the deal attracted AUD 3.00 billion of demand. The 5.5-year tranches carried a spread of 1.52 percent, while the 10-year note stood 1.77 percent above the three-month bank bill swap rate, according to The Australian. For investors, the figures point to funding capacity and investor demand, while the longer maturity also exposes the group to a higher interest-cost base.

Upcoming dates carry the next catalyst

Macquarie's official investor calendar lists the 2027 half-year result announcement for November 6, 2026 and the expected ex-dividend date for November 11, 2026, according to Macquarie Group. Those dates give the market two separately timed reference points after the capital raising.

Macquarie stock stays in a wide range

The stock's Lang & Schwarz quote was EUR 157.67 on October 12, 2026 at 9:48 a.m. CEST. The bid was EUR 156.96 and the ask was EUR 158.38, keeping the displayed spread at EUR 1.42.

Macquarie Group trades on the ASX under ticker MQG, with the financial-services group classified in financials, according to Global Banking and Finance. The structured quote showed a market capitalization of AUD 93.5 billion, a 52-week range of AUD 187.31 to AUD 267.90 and fiscal 2026 net profit of AUD 4.85 billion.

The further course of trading is shown by the continuously updated real-time quote of Macquarie stock.

Company: Macquarie Group Limited

Price Lang & Schwarz as of October 12, 2026, 9:48 a.m. CEST: EUR 157.67

Market context: Market report S&P/ASX 200.
